title: Integrally closedness from a localization cocone.
statement: Given a filtered cocone whose objects are the localizations at contracted primes and whose cocone point is a specified ring, if every object localization is integrally closed then the cocone point ring is integrally closed.

source.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemma Tag 037D, common-stage lifting argument

proof.text: Lift a monic relation and its fraction to one common stage; integrally closedness at that stage puts the fraction in the stage, and the cocone map puts it in the cocone point.

mathlib_searches.query: filtered colimit of integrally closed rings

lean.statement: theorem integrallyClosed_of_localization_cocone {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (D : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone D) (hc : c.pt = CommRingCat.of R) (hD : ∀ i : I, IsIntegrallyClosed (D.obj i)) : IsIntegrallyClosed R
